newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate falls, baht stronger late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate falls, baht stronger late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate dipped further to 9.00-9.50 percent in late Wednesday trade from 10.25-10.50 in early morning as liquidity steadily improved, dealers said.
Heavy selling of the dollar and steady inflow of foreign funds this week helped boosted market liquidity and pushed the interbank rate down again today, they added.
"As foreign funds continue to flow into the system, the interbank rate will be on a declining trend tomorrow," said one dealer at a foreign bank.

Dealers said foreign sentiment on the Thai economy and financial markets had improved since Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa last Friday dissolved pariliament and called a snap election. for November 17.
The baht was higher to 25.427-25.430 to the dollar late from 25.435-25.440 in early dealings as the dollar weakened abroad, dealers said.

The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 7.50/8.50 satangs per dollar late compared with 7.00/7.75 in early morning. The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate unchanged at 25.43 to the dollar. -- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
